items.question: Does the neighbouring-card item offer all three approaches as its Options: bounded shared space, nearest only and contour pressure?

source.quote: Compare all three unresolved neighbouring-card approaches

items.question: Is each neighbouring-card approach's ink shown with the pointer far away, near a card, and between two cards?

source.quote: show each approach's ink at a few pointer positions: far, near, and between two cards

items.question: Do the mocks show Episode cards with real content (a title, caption, tags, release date and a "Watch on YouTube" action) rather than placeholder boxes?
Is the ink drawn as an irregular liquid pool anchored at the card's rounded border, rather than as a fixed shape that grows, zooms or floats free?

source.quote: anchor the pool at the nearest point of its rounded border

items.question: Does the page say that approving it does not authorise production changes?

source.quote: Approving does not authorise production changes.
